shared_context_help: The same structure appears in another collection. Confidence, review dates, and scored answers are shared; your notes stay with each entry.
axis_context_help: The hypothalamus is one structure in the hypothalamic–pituitary axis. Study the organ and the wider signaling pathway separately.
parent_context_help: Pancreatic islets are hormone-producing clusters within the pancreas. Study them separately from the whole organ.
muscle_tension_fact: Muscles generate pulling tension. They can shorten, hold a steady length, or lengthen while active. The biceps helps bend the elbow; the triceps helps straighten it.
quads_mechanism_scope: Representative skeletal-muscle fiber mechanism, also used by the quadriceps. This is a cellular schematic, not a drawing of the thigh.
motion_force_outcome: Cross-bridge forces create tension; during the shortening phase of the climb, sarcomeres shorten.
motion_force_feedback: Myosin cross-bridges generate pulling force on actin. An active muscle can generate tension while shortening, holding its length, or lengthening.
motion_goal_exercise: Explain how muscle force, joint movement, blood flow, and gas exchange support climbing stairs.
motion_predict_exercise: The air–blood barrier becomes thicker. With other factors unchanged, will oxygen transfer decrease, increase, or stay the same?
motion_transfer_exercise: You hold a bag still with your elbow bent. Which explanation fits the active arm muscles?
motion_exercise_a: No joint movement means no muscle tension.
motion_exercise_b: Muscles can produce tension while holding their length.
motion_exercise_c: Muscles push the bones to keep the bag still.
motion_explain_exercise: An isometric contraction produces tension without visible joint movement. A contraction does not always mean shortening.
motion_goal_meal: Connect intestinal surface area, absorption, and transport to the delivery of nutrients.
motion_predict_meal: Villi become shorter, reducing absorptive surface area. With other factors unchanged, will nutrient absorption decrease, increase, or stay the same?
motion_transfer_meal: Villi are intact, but their lacteals cannot carry lymph away. Which transport route is most directly affected?
motion_meal_b: Oxygen entering blood in the lungs.
motion_meal_c: Chylomicrons carrying absorbed long-chain dietary fats into lymph.
motion_explain_meal: Lacteals carry chylomicrons through lymph. Sugars and amino acids generally enter blood capillaries; absorption and onward transport are different links.
motion_goal_wound: Trace how clotting, immune responses, blood supply, and tissue rebuilding cooperate during repair.
motion_predict_wound: Blood supply to rebuilding tissue falls and inflammation persists. Will the time needed to close the wound decrease, increase, or stay the same?
motion_transfer_wound: The skin surface has closed. Which statement best describes what may still happen underneath?
motion_wound_a: Collagen can continue to reorganize as the tissue remodels.
motion_wound_b: All repair stops the instant the surface closes.
motion_wound_c: The repaired tissue must already have its original strength.
motion_explain_wound: Surface closure and completion of repair are different. Remodeling continues, and repaired tissue may not regain its original strength.
motion_goal_fluid: Distinguish how much fluid is filtered from which substances cross the kidney filter.
motion_predict_fluid: The glomerular barrier becomes more permeable to plasma proteins. Will protein entering the filtrate decrease, increase, or stay the same?
motion_transfer_fluid: In a different model, less fluid is filtered but the barrier remains intact. Does the smaller filtered volume alone show that protein is leaking?
motion_fluid_a: Yes. Filtered volume and protein selectivity are the same property.
motion_fluid_b: No. Filtration volume and barrier selectivity are different properties.
motion_fluid_c: Yes. Any reduction in filtered volume means more protein crosses.
motion_explain_fluid: A change in filtered volume does not by itself establish protein leakage. The amount filtered and the barrier’s selectivity must be considered separately.
